basis.justification: Reviewed operational ceilings, not a performance prediction. Budget 24 hours rather than reuse the staging-only 3-hour request. Each full cell reserves 15 minutes processing, 5 minutes export and 10 minutes CPU reference, even when the stage omits a component. Each pilot reserves 20 minutes exhaustive CPU reference. Qualification and bounded batch/tail/transition acceptance precede pilots. Stop incomplete on any timeout or insufficient remaining campaign budget; never shorten counts, skip gates, or silently extend the job. GPU fit and compute throughput have not yet been measured for batch200.
